rows.title: 2-D Laplace BEM (interior / exterior)
rows.claim: Constant-panel indirect BEM, analytic panel integrals, circle solid-angle identity.

rows.title: 3-D Laplace BEM (interior / exterior)
rows.claim: Triangular constant panels with Duffy quadrature; sphere and interior-harmonic references.

rows.title: 2-D deep-water free-surface Green function
rows.claim: Wave/Rankine split; the singular log term is integrated analytically per panel.

rows.title: 3-D Delhommeau / Kelvin free-surface Green function
rows.claim: Region-split evaluator with continuous seams and free-surface residual below 1e-14.

rows.title: 3-D unbaffled exterior Helmholtz acoustic BEM (radiation + scattering + ICES 209)
rows.claim: Complex-wavenumber layer potentials with exact solid-angle double layer, CHIEF-point irregular-frequency suppression, radiation/scattering split, and ICES 209 one-third-octave band output; validated against the pulsating-sphere closed form (1.1 %) and the rigid-sphere Mie series (1.6 %).

rows.title: Ursell submerged-cylinder radiation benchmark
rows.claim: Multipole reference independent of the panel code; first-order convergence pinned.

rows.title: Hulme floating hemisphere (3-D radiation)
rows.claim: Semi-analytical reference, convergence orders 1.93-2.06, Haskind reciprocity below 0.2%.

rows.title: Near-boundary near-singular panel quadrature + hemisphere heave Hulme anchor
rows.claim: Two independent routes (adaptive midpoint subdivision, graded polar with rho = eps*sinh(t)) hold their error level down to eps/h = 1e-3 against a semi-analytic arbiter, the plain Duffy rule fails the same limit (negative control), and hemisphere heave A33/B33 matches Hulme (1982) within 1.2% on the certified 1024-panel grid with a near/far energy residual below 1e-6 for the analytic radiating field.
rows.note: The <1e-6 near/far residual belongs to the analytic radiating field; the constant-panel BEM pair reaches 1.4e-4 at 1024 panels and is reported separately, never quoted as 1e-6.

rows.title: MacCamy-Fuchs vertical pile (Helmholtz + CHIEF)
rows.claim: Bessel/Hankel reference; CHIEF removes the irregular-frequency instability.

rows.title: Dean diffraction (zero-reflection theorem)
rows.claim: Reflection modulus at round-off and exact energy balance at ka=0.6.

rows.title: Rigid-body added mass (2-D / 3-D Neumann)
rows.claim: Lamb closed forms for cylinder, ellipse and ellipsoid; free-surface-free Neumann solve.

rows.title: Surface velocity recovery
rows.claim: Patch fit recovers the tangential gradient from the potential jump on the surface.

rows.title: Hydrostatics (volume, Cb, waterplane, restoration)
rows.claim: Closed-form barge/spheroid/hemisphere values reproduced by the meshed hull.

rows.title: 6-DOF heave RAO coupling
rows.claim: Radiation plus hydrostatic coupling reproduces the analytic single-DOF oscillator RAO.

rows.title: Finite-depth kernels + solver (2-D)
rows.claim: Dispersion relation, evanescent modes and bottom condition at arbitrary depth h.
rows.note: Published as out of scope on 2026-10-29; shipped later with a dedicated suite.

rows.title: Finite-depth kernels + solver (3-D)
rows.claim: Vertical mode expansion, bessel_k0 evaluator and analytic gradients in the 3-D kernel.
rows.note: Published as out of scope on 2026-10-29; shipped later with a dedicated suite.

rows.title: Forward-speed wave resistance (Wigley, Michell/Kochin)
rows.claim: Michell-Kochin integral and pressure-integral forms agree; Wigley Cb = 4/9 verified.
rows.note: Published as out of scope on 2026-10-29; shipped later with a dedicated suite.

rows.title: Michell thin-ship wave resistance for general hulls + tandem interference
rows.claim: Centreplane panel discrete Kochin function reproduces the closed-form Wigley and the elliptic-coordinate ellipsoid references (< 1e-4), and the tandem pair interference factor sigma = R_pair/(2 R_single) reproduces the closed-form superposition at gaps L/2, L, 2L with three-grid GCI < 3 %.
rows.note: Agreement is between independent implementations of the same thin-ship theory (panel discretisation vs closed form / quadrature); no experimental claim is made.

rows.title: Kutta condition / lifting foil
rows.claim: Joukowski foil circulation enforces the Kutta condition; lift within 3% of the exact value.
rows.note: Published as out of scope on 2026-10-29; shipped later with a dedicated suite.

rows.title: Mixed Dirichlet / Neumann boundaries
rows.claim: Per-panel boundary-type assembly validated against a manufactured mixed field.

rows.title: Near-singular panel integration
rows.claim: Adaptive subdivision keeps the near-field integral converging as the clearance shrinks.

rows.title: Symmetry reduction (3-D)
rows.claim: Half-domain assembly reproduces the full-domain answer to solver tolerance.

rows.title: Pressure integration and force recovery
rows.claim: Bernoulli pressure integrated on the panels reproduces the classical closed force.

rows.title: Conditioning diagnostics
rows.claim: Condition number, operator conditions and their trend are reported and pinned.

rows.title: Mesh quality gates
rows.claim: Degenerate and low-quality panels are diagnosed before assembly.

rows.title: Declared-number registry
rows.claim: Every number printed in the documents is registered, re-measured and judged per tier.

rows.title: Document-versus-artifact claim gate
rows.claim: Published Ursell numbers are parsed from the documents and compared with a measured artifact.

rows.title: Kramers-Kronig causality check
rows.claim: Hilbert-transform consistency of added mass and damping on the exact causal pair.

rows.title: Body / free-surface clearance diagnostics
rows.claim: Minimum clearance is classified far/near deterministically and feeds the error budget.

rows.title: Benchmark drivers expose a runnable entry point
rows.claim: Each benchmark driver parses its documented CLI and keeps its analytic reference path wired.
rows.note: Entry-point contract only; the numerical verification of these drivers is cited per capability above.

rows.title: Machine-derived capability evidence registry
rows.claim: The baseline's capability table is derived from code/test/doc evidence and drift-gated.
rows.note: This capability: the table below is its own output.

rows.title: Second-order mean wave drift force (near field / far field)
rows.claim: Near-field pressure-plus-waterline drift and the Maruo far field agree on a wall-anchored body and on a cylinder, with a Richardson-converged panel gate.
rows.note: Absent from the 2026-10-29 table; the capability existed there as prose only.

rows.title: Maruo far-field mean drift force at arbitrary heading
rows.claim: The azimuthal Maruo integral with the frame-covariant weight e_beta - e_theta reproduces the closed-form drift force (rho g/4)(2 pi C^2 e_beta - a pi C^2 e_gamma) of a Kochin pattern |K|^2 = C^2 (1 + a cos(theta - gamma)) at every heading to < 1e-5 relative, and rotating body and incident waves together by alpha rotates the force by alpha (residual < 1e-9).
rows.note: The reference is the closed-form azimuthal integral of the same far-field theory, not experimental drift data; the sampled Kochin table, not n_theta, sets the accuracy floor.

rows.title: Time-domain radiation memory kernel (Cummins equation)
rows.claim: The Fourier round trip returns A and B for an exact exponential pair and the Cummins free decay reproduces the auxiliary-ODE characteristic decay.
rows.note: Absent from the 2026-10-29 table.

rows.title: Radiation-damping rational fit (Sanathanan-Koerner iteration)
rows.claim: The SK iteration relocates the decay rates instead of fixing them on a log grid: on a curve that is exactly a sum of three real decay rates it recovers the rates, residues and asymptote to 1.2e-15 where the pre-rewrite fixed-grid fit misses by 8.1e-01 at the same order, and it is never worse than that baseline anywhere in the order scan. The measured Hulme hemisphere curve is NOT representable by real decay rates (12-order floor 1.7e-01 against a 1.3e-06 unconstrained rational ceiling), which is reported, not hidden.

rows.title: Coupled multi-DOF radiation memory kernel matrix
rows.claim: The kernel matrix built from a two-mode sweep closes three independent round trips: the transform (B to 0.6 % of peak, A to 0.3 %), the time-domain convolution under a prescribed two-mode motion (0.2 % pointwise against [omega^2 A - i omega B] X), and the coupled free decay against the frequency-domain damping ratio (3.4 % against the quadratic form, 0.2 % against the exact complex resonance of the same kernel). K(t<0) is zero, the K_ij(0+) jump matches (2/pi) int B_ij including the sign of the cross entry, and a zero-damping control decays at 1e-9 of the physical rate.
rows.note: Cross entries may be negative, so the scalar passivity rule (B >= 0) is replaced by positive semidefiniteness of the damping matrix; the trapezoid memory sum is first order and every decay rate is Richardson-extrapolated in dt.

rows.title: Two-way Cummins memory-kernel closure with causality and decay gates
rows.claim: On a deeply submerged sphere the memory kernel closes the frequency-to-time-to-frequency loop (B to 0.03 %, A to 1.9 % of its peak inside the resolvable band), is exactly zero for negative time with an upward K(0+) jump equal to (2/pi) int B dw to 1e-5 relative, and the Cummins free decay reproduces the frequency-domain damping ratio to 1.5 % (energy identity) while the zero-damping control decays at 3e-6 of the physical rate.
rows.note: The A-side round trip and the Kramers-Kronig leg are reported relative to the added-mass peak; the conditioning floor of the principal-value leg is in the report.

rows.title: Discretisation and recovery uncertainty quantification
rows.claim: Richardson/GCI recovers a manufactured order and limit, and the bootstrap intervals have measured empirical coverage on known samples.
rows.note: Absent from the 2026-10-29 table; the GCI numbers quoted in the drift and Wigley reports come from here.

rows.title: Hydroelastic panel modes and the wet/dry frequency ratio
rows.claim: The dry natural frequency is the Kirchhoff closed form and the modal added-mass ratio has an exact uniform limit; the plate is simply supported and excitation is Froude-Krylov only.
rows.note: Model-internal evidence only: the document registers absolute validation against an independent hydroelastic code or experiment as WITHHELD.

rows.title: Ice-cover mass loading, ice-region RAO and ice-class hull geometry
rows.claim: Mass-loading dispersion is pinned to Weitz-Keller and to independent RK4 shooting, the vanishing-ice limit recovers open water, and the ice-class mesh reproduces its parametric block coefficient.
rows.note: The PC6 hull is parametric: the offset table is not public property, so absolute RAO magnitudes in ice remain WITHHELD in the document.

rows.title: Piecewise-linear panel operators and tangential recovery smoothing
rows.claim: The linear-panel self integral matches the graded Duffy rule and smoothing preserves the area-weighted mean exactly.
rows.note: Absent from the 2026-10-29 table; the order study it belongs to is published as docs/panel_linear_order.md.

rows.title: Multiply connected 2-D domains (nested loops, multi-component meshes)
rows.claim: The annulus Dirichlet solve converges to the closed form and the recovered boundary flux is divergence free on both loops.
rows.note: Absent from the 2026-10-29 table.

rows.title: Thin-ship Michell resistance for general hullforms and tandem pairs
rows.claim: The panel Kochin function matches the closed form, the panel resistance route matches the repository quadrature, and the tandem interference reduces to the analytic double-hull limits.
rows.note: Thin-ship asymptotics: the agreement is with Michell theory, not with experiment.

rows.title: Near-singular quadrature and conditioning diagnostics
rows.claim: Source/target pairs are classified by distance over panel size in 2-D and 3-D, and the combined report round-trips through JSON and Markdown.
rows.note: Diagnostics only: the report classifies conditioning, it does not certify accuracy.

rows.title: Panel and triangle mesh geometry with closure checks
rows.claim: Refining the icosphere converges the discrete area and volume to the sphere values, and open or misoriented meshes are rejected before any solve.
rows.note: Absent from the 2026-10-29 table although every row above depends on it.

rows.title: Parametric KCS-class hull with published-particular anchors
rows.claim: A fully parametric container-ship hull is solved to the published KCS L/B/T/Cb/Cm, passes the Cb/L/B/T mesh gate before any solve, and reports its waterplane-coefficient deficit instead of hiding it; the real KCS offset table and its EFD loads stay WITHHELD.
reasons: no documentation anchor for the claim
rows.note: Geometry anchors only: the hull is an idealisation (Cwp 17 % below the KCS value, no bulb or appendages), so KCS predictions and the EFD comparison remain WITHHELD (limitations L2/L3).

rows.title: Multihull added mass and damping with exact zero/infinite-frequency asymptotes
rows.claim: Two and three Wigley hulls abreast are solved in the 3-D free-surface BEM for sway, heave and pitch, and the two frequency limits A(0) (rigid-wall free surface) and A(inf) (pressure-release free surface) are obtained from an independent Laplace collocation on the mirror-closed double body, so the frequency sweep is checked against a potential solve rather than against itself.
rows.note: Linear potential flow, zero speed, deep water; the infinite-frequency value from the sweep is a Kramers-Kronig 1/omega^2 extrapolation anchored to the pressure-release solve.  No experimental multihull added-mass table exists in the repository, so the error judgement is against analytic hydrostatics and the independent potential solve.

rows.title: Wigley III diffraction/RAO and cylinder drift maturity surface
rows.claim: Three-route exciting-force agreement, geometry gate (Cb/volume/waterplane), heave-pitch RAO solve.
rows.note: Verification surface, not a new solver: it pins the closed-form Wigley III hydrostatics and gates a panel mesh against them before any hydrodynamic number is quoted.

rows.title: Second-order difference-frequency QTF and slow-drift spectra
rows.claim: Off-diagonal QTF by quadratic pressure and by Newman approximation, arbitrated on the diagonal.
rows.note: Newman approximation is exact on the diagonal by construction, which is the invariant the tests assert; the off-diagonal direct route is compared against it, not against a recalled table.

rows.title: Fast multipole acceleration of the 3-D single-layer operator
rows.claim: Octree + real spherical harmonics; far-field slope and per-leaf exactness at low level.
rows.note: Degenerates exactly to direct summation at a single leaf; order law checked against the theoretical slope.

rows.title: Independent finite-difference check of the flexural-gravity dispersion
rows.claim: Depth factor k tanh(kH) recovered by a finite-difference solve, so the closed form has a second route.
rows.note: Cross-implementation anchor for the ice-plate dispersion shipped in m14560.

rows.title: 3-D Laplace BEM cathodic protection (linear polarisation + Butler-Volmer)
rows.claim: Ship-hull cathodic-protection current and potential distribution by the 3-D Laplace BEM with coating-damage masks, a waterline lid and (separately) Butler-Volmer steel/anode kinetics; graded against the analytic cylinder log-potential anchor and closed box/annulus mesh geometry.

rows.title: Exact MacCamy-Fuchs cylinder drift + 3-D far-field drift
rows.claim: Mean second-order drift on a surface-piercing cylinder from the exact MacCamy-Fuchs field (near-field momentum integral) and the 3-D far-field route: BEM Kochin coupling, Maruo reduced kernel, control-circle radius scan and the optical-theorem residual identity.

rows.title: Verification-figure integrity gate (reproducible from committed data)
rows.claim: Every verification figure is re-rendered from its committed JSON and compared to the shipped PNG, with report-linkage checks; the gate fails on a figure that cannot be regenerated from committed data.

rows.title: Finite-depth Green function + dispersion solver
rows.claim: Finite-depth free-surface Green function with a Newton-Raphson dispersion solver, steady-flow wavenumber and explicit deep-water / shallow-water degeneration checks on the kernels and on the resistance integral.

rows.title: 3-D finite-depth wave-radiation solver (eigenseries + quadrature kernels)
rows.claim: Three-dimensional finite-depth radiation/diffraction BEM for closed bodies with the John eigenseries kernel and the quadrature kernel, strict submersion checks on the quadrature path, and a deep-water limit comparison.

rows.title: Flexural-gravity (ice-cover) dispersion and mass loading
rows.claim: Elastic ice-plate flexural-gravity dispersion (omega^2 = g k tanh(kH) + D k^5/rho_w), its open-water and in-vacuo short-wave limits, group velocity, and the unified flexural-gravity + mass-loading branch; cross-checked against an independent hydroelastic implementation.

rows.title: 2-D Haskind excitation + net-source regularisation (strip theory)
rows.claim: Haskind-Newman excitation from the radiation potential alone, cross-validated against a direct diffraction solve at the same strip station, together with the low-frequency net-source (gauge-band) regularisation of the 2-D radiation/diffraction problems.

rows.title: Interior waterplane-lid panels (irregular-frequency suppression)
rows.claim: Interior waterplane-lid panel sets used to suppress 3-D irregular-frequency spikes: ring structure at a requested resolution, rejection of closed submerged meshes and of invalid resolutions.

rows.title: Irregular-frequency prediction and sanitisation
rows.claim: Irregular-frequency prediction from the interior Dirichlet eigenproblem plus two sanitisation routes (CHIEF points, interior surface); the condition number and the spike suppression are asserted on a frequency sweep.

rows.title: Neumann-Kelvin steady forward-speed wave resistance
rows.claim: Steady Neumann-Kelvin Green function with the Kelvin wave pattern, Froude scaling helpers and the wave-resistance integral, checked for far-field decay and against the Michell limit.

rows.title: 3-D steady Neumann-Kelvin panel method (Rankine + Havelock kernel)
rows.claim: Three-dimensional steady Neumann-Kelvin panel method: Rankine source panels plus the Havelock free-surface kernel, centreplane panel areas, far-field prefactor scaling and the free-surface condition residual on the collocation points.

rows.title: Quadratic (6-node) curved-triangle panel operator
rows.claim: Quadratic curved-triangle layer operators: shape functions and gradients with a partition-of-unity check, Duffy self-quadrature, graded near-singular subtriangles and the resulting BEM solve; graded by an order-of-convergence study on a curved element.

rows.title: Propeller open-water performance by vortex-lattice lifting surface
rows.claim: Vortex-lattice (lifting-surface) propeller model: helical wake geometry, blade chord/expanded-area consistency, Kutta-Joukowski force on each segment and Froude-scaled open-water coefficients.

rows.title: Rankine-source free-surface panel method (truncated domain)
rows.claim: Dense 3-D Rankine-source BEM on a truncated free-surface domain with Neumann condition on the body and radiation on the outer boundary: the double-body case carries no wave resistance and a small Neumann residual, and the Wigley case reports a grid-convergence index.

rows.title: Rankine wave resistance + Series 60 empirical reference
rows.claim: Rankine-source wave-making resistance for the Wigley hull with an energy-flux and free-surface-truncation study, plus the Series 60 empirical wave-resistance data used as the validation reference.

rows.title: Machine-checked provenance of reference constants
rows.claim: Every literature/experimental constant registered with a source note and a citation that must still resolve in the repository; a negative control proves the scanner catches a recalled (unsourced) mapping.

rows.title: State-space realisation of the Cummins radiation memory
rows.claim: Vector fitting of the added-mass/damping data (Sanathanan-Koerner) into a stable state-space realisation, bridged to the time-domain impulse-response convolution; stability, JSON serialisability and the frequency/time agreement are asserted.

rows.title: STF (1970) strip theory with forward speed
rows.claim: Salvesen-Tuck-Faltinsen strip theory with forward speed: encounter frequency, speed-correction terms that vanish at zero speed, section coefficients converging to the Ursell values for a deep submerged circle, and a grid-convergence index on a33.

rows.title: Slack-tank free-surface correction to hydrostatics
rows.claim: Liquid free-surface correction to the hydrostatic restoring matrix from polygon moments: translation invariance, the metacentric form of the diagonal entries and the cross-coupling produced by an L-shaped tank.

rows.title: Wigley III hullform geometry (frequency-domain verification hull)
rows.claim: Wigley III hull form generators for the frequency-domain radiation/diffraction/RAO verification cases: closed-form volume, block coefficient, wetted area, and mesh panel counts / on-surface convergence against the analytic values.
